description:
Read the project's relations.REL file — the durable schema metadata that describes how datafiles in the project link to each other. Written automatically by chaprola_import when nested.mode is "auto" or "explicit"; editable via /relations/{add,update,remove}.

Use this BEFORE writing a multi-file program so you know which file is the parent, which is the child, what the FK column is named, and whether cascade_delete / cascade_update is on. Saves a round-trip of stat'ing each .F file individually.

Response shape:

```json
{
  "version": "1.0",
  "project": "...",
  "updated_at": "...",
  "datafiles": {
    "USERS": {"primary_key": ["user_id"], "source_path": "users"},
    "USERS_ORDERS": {"primary_key": ["order_id"], "source_path": "users.orders", "parent_fk": "user_id"}
  },
  "relationships": [
    {
      "id": "users__orders",
      "kind": "containment",
      "parent": {"datafile": "USERS",        "field": "user_id"},
      "child":  {"datafile": "USERS_ORDERS", "field": "user_id"},
      "cardinality": "one-many",
      "match": "strict",
      "cascade_update": true,
      "cascade_delete": true
    }
  ]
}
```

If the project has never been imported with nested.mode set, returns `{"status":"empty","datafiles":{},"relationships":[]}`. Empty is not an error.

userid.description: Project owner's username. Required when accessing a shared project where you are a writer. Defaults to the authenticated user.

name: chaprola_relations
